en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Al Ahmasy, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The best of the assistance is the world, upon the seeking of the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali al-Ahmasiy from a man who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The worldly help in one’s quest for success in the hereafter is the best help.’”
